_comment: How each air case is looked up in the SADA archive (web/scripts/cases-match.mjs). args go to find_flights; keep = callsigns that belong to the reported movement (others returned for the aircraft are dropped); match = how well the archive corroborates the report: exact (the reported movement is in the data), nearby (the aircraft or operator is seen on the route within a day, but the exact flight is unspecified or a leg is missing), dark (seen departing, destination lost), none.
